resolved.title: 继承
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Inheritance[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b]Inheritance [/b]provides a way to share functionality between classes. 
Imagine several classes, [b]Cat[/b], [b]Dog[/b], [b]Rabbit[/b] and so on. Although they may differ in some ways (only [b]Dog [/b]might have the method [b]bark[/b]), they are likely to be similar in others (all having the attributes [b]color [/b]and [b]name[/b]). 
This similarity can be expressed by making them all inherit from a [b]superclass Animal[/b], which contains the shared functionality. 
To inherit a class from another class, put the superclass name in parentheses after the class name.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example: [/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="408"]class Animal: 
  def __init__(self, name, color):
    self.name = name
    self.color = color

class Cat([b]Animal[/b]):
  def purr(self):
    print("Purr...")
        
class Dog([b]Animal[/b]):
  def bark(self):
    print("Woof!")

fido = Dog("Fido", "brown")
print(fido.color)
fido.bark()[/code]
[note][b]Run the code[/b] and see how it works![/note]

resolved.title: 类继承
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Inheritance[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A class that inherits from another class is called a [b]subclass[/b].
A class that is inherited from is called a [b]superclass[/b].
If a class inherits from another with the same attributes or methods, it overrides them. [code format="py" codeId="409"]class Wolf: 
  def __init__(self, name, color):
    self.name = name
    self.color = color

  def bark(self):
    print("Grr...")

class Dog(Wolf):
  def bark(self):
    print("Woof")
        
husky = Dog("Max", "grey")
husky.bark()[/code]
[note]In the example above, [b]Wolf [/b]is the superclass, [b]Dog [/b]is the subclass.[/note]

content.text:
继承自另一个类的类称为**子类**，被继承的类被称为**父类**。

如果子类存在于父类相同的属性或方法，子类就会覆盖它们。
content.text_html:
A class that inherits from another class is called a subclass. A class that is inherited from is called a superclass. If a class inherits from another with the same attributes or methods, it overrides them.

一个继承自另一个类的类被称为子类。 一个被继承的类被称为超类。 如果一个类从另一个类继承了相同的属性或方法，它就会覆盖它们。

resolved.title: 类继承
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Inheritance[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The function [b]super [/b]is a useful inheritance-related function that refers to the parent class. It can be used to find the method with a certain name in an object's superclass.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="411"]class A:
  def spam(self):
    print(1)

class B(A):
  def spam(self):
    print(2)
    [b]super().spam()[/b]
            
B().spam()[/code]
[note][b]super().spam() [/b]calls the [b]spam [/b]method of the superclass.[/note]
